div.l: Sownyng in mortal v̉ertu / was his speche
And gladly wold he lerne / a gladly teche
A Sergant of Lawe ASeriaıı̄unt of the lawe / war and wys
That ofte hadde I be / at the parvis
He was also / wol ryche of excellence
Discret he was / and of gret reverence
He seemed such / his wordis were so wyse
Iustice he was offten / in assyce
By patent / and bi pleyn commyssyoıı̄un
For his science / and his hih renoıı̄un
Of feeis and robis / had he many ooıı̄un
So gret a purchasour / was nowher nooıı̄un
Al was fee symple / to hym in effecte
Nowher so besy a man · as he / ther nas ·
His purchasyng / myht nat be infect
And yit he seemed bysiere / than he was
In termes had he cas / and domys alle
That fro the tyme / of king Wyllyam wer falle ·
Therto he cowde endyte / and make a thyng
Ther cowde no wight / pynche at his wrytyng
And eủery statute / cowde he pleyne be roote
He rood but homly / in a medly coote
Girt with a seynt of silk / with barres smale
Of his array / telle I no lengere tale
A Frankeleyn̄ A Frankeleyn̄ was / in his companye
White was his berd / as it the dayeseye
Of his complexion̄ / he was sangveyn
Weel loved he bi the morowe / a soppe in wyn
To leven in delit / was euer his wone
For he was Epicurus / owne sone
That held oppynyon̄ / that pleyn̄ delit
Was verray felycyte / ꝑperfyt
An housholdere / and that agret was he
Seynt Iulyan / he was cleped in his contre
